published_reviews.title: Argentine Government Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Generic national award is not identified by programme-specific documentation; CONICET 2026 doctoral awards are separately named, have 2027 start, and 2026 deadlines. Do not relabel or imply CONICET eligibility without matching the programme.

published_reviews.title: University of Buenos Aires Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: No UBA programme-specific funding call established. CONICET is external funding, not evidence of a universal UBA stipend. Retain review.

published_reviews.title: University of São Paulo Phd International Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: USP archaeology programme allocates CAPES/CNPq graduate awards subject to vacancies; no guaranteed FAPESP stipend for every USP PhD student.

published_reviews.title: University of São Paulo (USP) Graduate Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Faculty of Education 2026/27 internal CAPES/CNPq selection occurred March 23–29, 2026; departmental calls are not one university-wide scholarship.

published_reviews.title: University of São Paulo Masters International Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: CAPES/CNPq awards depend on specific postgraduate programme, availability and selection; no automatic FAPESP stipend for all international Master's applicants.

published_reviews.title: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile Masters Excellence Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: UC 2027 ANID Doctorado Nacional evidence is for a separate doctoral external competition; cannot validate this generic Master's scholarship.

published_reviews.title: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: UC Astrophysics 2027 PhD admission programme has specific conditional internal stipend/fee support, not proof of universal UC-wide full scholarship.

published_reviews.title: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile Computer Science Phd Award
published_reviews.evidence_note: ANID national PhD programme has a Nov 27 2026 deadline, but it is external and cannot be copied to a generic UC computer science award.

published_reviews.title: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile Masters International Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: No independently identified 2027 UC Master's award supporting universal tuition and stipend. Distinguish AGCID national external scholarships from UC awards.

published_reviews.title: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile Phd International Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: UC Astrophysics PhD provides conditional four-year support for admitted students with valid ANID applications; cannot generalize across all UC PhDs.

published_reviews.title: Pontificia Universidad Javeriana Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Existing 2026-2 Bachiller Destacado private draft is a named, expired, distinct award; do not treat generic Javeriana listing as automatically full funded.

published_reviews.title: Universidad de los Andes Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Generic university homepage is not programme-specific evidence of a universal full-tuition scholarship; identify current scheme before any verification.

published_reviews.title: EARTH University Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Institutional homepage only; need 2027 financial aid programme-specific rules, award scope, and nationality criteria.

published_reviews.title: Mexican Government Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Official 2026 AMEXCID Excellence Scholarship for foreigners exists. Another published record titled Mexican Government AMEXCID Scholarship already exists (5ded3ae0-0b55-4f6c-83dd-e82487895ad4). Reconcile duplicate before updates; 2027 call not confirmed.

published_reviews.title: Tecnológico de Monterrey Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: Tec has separate grants, grant-plus-loan and Líderes del Mañana 2027 100% tuition scheme. Never label socio-economic loan component as a grant. For Líderes, PAA 1360 required; SAT not established as mandatory; national and LATAM applicant pools restricted.

published_reviews.title: UNAM Phd Excellence Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: SECIHTI postgraduate grants are separately administered; UNAM students must apply and qualify, not an automatic named UNAM PhD Excellence award.

published_reviews.title: UNAM Masters Excellence Scholarship
published_reviews.evidence_note: 2026 SECIHTI Master's support is separate and application-based; 2026 reference monthly MXN 16047.99 at political/social sciences, not a guaranteed university-wide stipend.

quality_rules: Do not mark reviewed records verified from generic homepage or source-audit alone
AGCID 2027 two distinct programmes; do not merge Nelson Mandela with Republic of Chile
AGCID platform Oct 30 2026 deadline is NOT the individual applicant's deadline; national focal points can close earlier
AGCID Nelson Mandela includes airfare while Republic of Chile does not
Tec socioeconomic scholarship can contain a repayable loan; never present loan as grant
No default IELTS/TOEFL/SAT requirement without programme-specific documentation
Do not count individual awards, courses, routes, or applicant tracks as separate programmes without independent programme identity
Transient HTTP errors are not discontinuation evidence
Source excerpts and proposed fields are research artifacts only, not accepted field provenance
